title: 第21章 热血上涌，陆阳带头干架！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “四班长，我问你，这啫喱水是干嘛用的？”“报告，喷，喷头发......”“喷头发？你这冬瓜毛，能整出造型来？”宿舍楼前，连长高峰一把打飞四班长帽子，脸贴脸的喷了他一脸唾沫。挨了骂的四班长一动不敢动，但喉咙却咕咚了一下。高峰看着手里的啫喱水，冷笑道：“才刚进部队，你就教新兵投机取巧，用啫喱水给被子定型？你这个班长，当的好啊，太好了！”他重重的在四班长肩膀上捏了两下，随后来到新兵队伍前头，怒声说道：“待会结束，把四班内务卫生流动红旗给我摘了，丢人现眼的玩意儿！”四班全体新兵一个个像是吃了死苍蝇似的，为了那面流动红旗，他们是起早贪黑的投机取巧。甚至为了拿到这项荣誉好几天不洗脚，硬是用脚臭味来掩盖啫喱水的香味。就是为了在检查的时候蒙混过关，结果没想到百密一疏。一场突击检查，让他们功亏一篑。高峰严肃的说：“当兵，不是糊弄。一床被子都弄虚作假，训练还能认真？”“基本功不扎实，上了战场死都不知道怎么死的，别以为我在跟你们开玩笑！”全体新兵噤若寒蝉，就这么看着连长在上头发火。陆阳脸色也很难看，他现在满脑子都是那包烟的事儿。虽然烟是班长给的，但毕竟是在自已柜子里搜出来的，倒霉的肯定还得是自已。这种事解释不清，只会越描越黑，况且三班被子大多也被丢了出来，班长这会儿自身都难保。陆阳唯一能做的，就只有死扛到底，认罪认罚.......高峰从指导员手里拿过塑料袋，丁玲桄榔的把东西全都倒在地上，都是各种违禁品。“扑克，香烟，火柴，你们一个个的课余生活很丰富啊？”“当班长的，是不是全都眼睛瞎了！啊？”“还有人把小说给拷到mp3里头，半夜躲在被窝里偷偷摸摸的看。”“我就想不明白了，这东西就这么好看，就这么大瘾？小说里的主角再强大，那也不是你，成天在这做梦想屁吃！”陆阳忽然有种，被连长给指着鼻子骂的感觉。因为他之前就常这么干，经常看到凌晨，导致白天上课没精神。但这东西不碰还行，碰上了瘾是真的大，尤其是追的书还没完结。每天等更新的时候就跟身上有蚂蚁爬一样，恨不能把作者关到小黑屋里头，一天码十万字出来才好。高峰发完火，指导员何镇涛来打圆场：“部队不是不让你们放松，不是不让你们玩，但得注意分寸。”“这些个违禁品全部没收，各班长待会回去以后要带头做检讨，明天晨会交上来。”“另外，在这里着重表扬一下三班.......”“嗯？”周凯东和陆阳的惊讶几乎是同步的。他俩是怎么都没想到，非但没被批评，反而还得到了表扬？何镇涛开口道：“虽然，三班的内务标准并不是最出色的，但却是全连唯一没有搜出违禁品的班级。在纪律方面，一排长做了很好的带头表率。”“这周的纪律作风流动红旗，提前发放给你们三班，要继续保持。”“是！！”周凯东鼻涕泡差点没乐出来，幸福来得也太突然了！紧跟着，高峰也开了口：“四班那流动红旗，给我挂到三班去！这次检查，三班内务水平进步很大，当做表扬了！”周凯东都快被突如其来的两个荣誉砸傻了：“谢谢连长指导员！”高峰也懒得再看这群棒槌，摆摆手宣布解散，让他们抓紧把被子拾回去。新兵们解散后，也开始玩起了一种名为“找啊找啊找被子”的游戏。“你这床被子，好像是我的吧？”“不会吧，我这有标记的？”“我这也有标记！”“我那标记，是自已半夜打标枪，画地图画上去的！”“哦哦哦，那不好意思，我是用黑笔做的记号，还是你拿走吧......”突击检查，扔被子并不是随便扔的。稍微好点儿的丢在走廊上，实在差的没眼看了，才会被扔到窗外。运气好的，能在地上花坛里捡回一床被子，但是不是自已的就不清楚了。运气实在不好的被丢到树上，还得爬到树上去把被子弄下来，结果发现还是他娘的别人的。孔垄就是这么个倒霉蛋，找了半天都没能找回自已的被子，还是陆阳支招让他随便拿一床干净没异味的，拿到就是赚到。反正被子的总量是不变的，最后每个人都会分到一床，不用那么纠结。指点完孔垄，陆阳飞快返回宿舍，幸好被子还在床上。但柜子里的烟和打火机已经不翼而飞，显然是被收走了。他挠着头，百思不得其解？明明自已柜子的违禁品已经被发现了，可却什么事儿都没有？“指导员好！”“陆阳，出来一下。”门口，何镇涛冲他招招手，陆阳赶紧关上柜子跑出去。原本，他以为这回肯定要挨骂挨罚了。却没想到，趁着没人注意，何镇涛竟又把烟跟火机塞给了他。“下不为例。”看着指导员离开的背影，陆阳终于明白为什么能顺利脱险了。他把烟揣进口袋，回宿舍后给了周凯东一个眼神，班长立马秒懂。是指导员在暗中发力，把陆阳给保了下来。部队里规章制度是死的，但人是活的；只要你足够优秀，自有大儒来辩经。这也让陆阳有了更加努力表现，积极向上的动力。原来堂哥说的都是真的，只要在部队里表现突出，班长的烟随便抽，连长的屁股随便摸！......周凯东将作风纪律流动红旗挂在墙上，两手叉腰的看着，脸上止不住的笑容。三班新兵看到这面流动红旗，也都乐乐呵呵的，由衷的高兴。“还愣着干什么，去四班把另一面流动红旗，也给我接回来啊！”“陆阳你带头，你们一起去，防止四班长那老小子耍赖不认账！”丁腾飞原本是不想凑这个热闹的，但周凯东命令他去，他这才不情不愿的跟着大部队后头上了楼。不知道为什么，跟在大家一块上楼时，他莫名有种在外头跟人约架的感觉。都是对立的两帮人，都是去找茬，都是找对方头头闹个说法回来。果不其然，到了楼上四班房门紧闭，显得极不愿意配合。陆阳作为班副，上去敲门：“四班长，我们来接流动红旗啦！”他嗓门喊得特别大，这层的其他班都能听得一清二楚，纷纷出来看热闹。很快，四班长打开了门，一脸阴沉沉的看着嬉皮笑脸的陆阳：“喊什么喊，我耳朵没聋！”陆阳嘿嘿笑道：“我们是奉班长的命令，来接流动红旗的，您不会不认账吧？”四班长本就窝火，现在瞧见一个新兵蛋子，居然敢跟自已蹬鼻子上脸，立马就来了火气。连长的命令他不敢违抗，但也绝对不会让这帮小子，这么容易就把他们班的旗给摘了。流动红旗，是基层部队最看重的集体荣誉，更是一个班的命根子！四班长召集全班新兵挡在门口，气势汹汹的用大拇指指了指后头。“流动红旗就挂在我们班门后头，有能耐的就自已进来拿！”“靠，这不是耍赖吗？”“老兵还以大欺小，太过分了！”“我们班长周凯东可是一排排长，职务比你大，你怎么能不讲理？”四班长堵在门口，掏了掏耳朵：“还是那句话，没本事就滚蛋，别妨碍我们班午休！”三班新兵气坏了，显然是没想到对方能这么无赖。陆阳上来的时候知道可能会碰上点麻烦，但没想到这么操蛋。讲道理是没用的，对方也表明了态度，不是我们不给是你自已进不来，就是闹到连长那去也没用。因为部队崇尚武力，这时候只能用武力来解决问题，而这恰恰是当下陆阳最不擅长的。但作为三班班副，既然来了就没有认怂的道理，今天必须把四班的旗摘回去！“兄弟们，给我抢！”陆阳一声令下，带头往里冲。刚一接触上，他就发了很操蛋的一件事。他这小身板，根本就不适合打头阵，应该让孔垄打头阵才对！现场两拨人一个往里挤，一个往外推，像极了抢亲时候的画面。但只有身处其中的陆阳清楚，这特么跟美式橄榄球似的，完全就是暴力的肢体接触。混乱中，陆阳鼻子还挨了一拳，当时就给他鼻血干下来了。“草！”见了红，陆阳的血性也上来了。抬起就是狠狠一脚，也不知道蹬在谁身上了。但看着四班长痛苦的表情，应该是踢在他身上了，而且还是正中弱点的那种。四班长气的咬牙切齿，声音都变尖了：“小王八蛋，下手是真特么狠呐，给我把他们推出去！”眼看对抗变得更加激烈，陆阳赶紧捂着鼻子赶紧战术性往后撤。但后头全是三班的人，死活就是挤不出去。双方都上头了，陆阳感觉肋骨都快被这帮人挤断了。好不容易往后挪了一个身位，又被孔垄这个大傻叉给挤到前面去。弄得陆阳都想喊救命了，他这会儿还在流着鼻血呢，战斗力比之前还要弱。好在这时，一只手从后方伸了出来，抓住他的脖领子后硬生生将他给拽了出来。原先，陆阳以为是周凯东来了，可回头才发现竟然是丁腾飞拉了他一把。只见丁腾飞气势汹汹的捋起袖子，扒开前头的人上去就是一脚，并伴随着一声国粹。“我__你妈！”（完形填空）
content_en: "Fourth squad leader, let me ask you, what is this gel water used for?" "Report, spray, spray hair..." "Spray hair? Can your winter melon hair be styled?" In front of the dormitory building, company commander Gao Feng knocked off the fourth squad leader's hat and sprayed him face to face with spittle.The fourth squad leader did not dare to move after being scolded, but there was a growl in his throat.Gao Feng looked at the gel water in his hand and sneered: "You just joined the army, and you teach the recruits to be opportunistic and use gel water to shape the quilt? You are a squad leader, great, great!" He pinched the fourth squad leader's shoulder hard twice, and then came to the recruit team.The head of Wu said angrily: "At the end of the meeting, take off the mobile red flag of the fourth class of internal sanitation for me. It's a shameful thing!" All the recruits of the fourth class seemed to have eaten dead flies. For the mobile red flag, they worked early and late to take advantage of the situation.Even in order to get this honor, I didn't wash my feet for several days and used the smell of my feet to cover up the fragrance of the gel water.Just to get through the inspection, but the result was unexpected.A surprise inspection failed them.Gao Feng said solemnly: "Being a soldier is not about fooling around. How can you be serious about training when you are lying all over the quilt?" "If you don't have solid basic skills, you won't know how to die on the battlefield. Don't think I'm kidding you!" All the recruits were silent, just watching the company commander get angry above.Lu Yang also looked ugly. His mind was now occupied with that pack of cigarettes.Although the cigarette was given by the squad leader, it was found in his own cabinet after all, so he must be the unlucky one.This kind of thing can't be explained clearly, and it will only get darker and darker. Moreover, most of the quilts in the third class have been thrown out, and the squad leader can't protect himself at this moment.The only thing Lu Yang could do was to fight to the end, plead guilty and accept punishment... Gao Feng took the plastic bag from the instructor's hand, and Ding Ling dumped everything on the ground, including all kinds of contraband."Poker, cigarettes, matches, you all have a rich after-school life?" "Are all the monitors blind?" "There are also people who copy novels into MP3s and hide under the quilt in the middle of the night."Look.""I just don't understand. Is this thing so good-looking and so addictive? No matter how powerful the protagonist is in the novel, it's not you who is just dreaming about it all day long!"Lu Yang suddenly felt like he was being scolded by the company commander.Because he often did this before, he often saw him in the early morning, which made him lack energy in class during the day.But it’s okay if you don’t touch it, but it’s really addicting if you touch it, especially when the book you’re following hasn’t been finished yet.Every day when I'm waiting for updates, I feel like there are ants crawling on my body. I wish I could lock the author in a dark room and type out 100,000 words a day.After Gao Feng was angry, the instructor He Zhentao came to smooth things over: "The army doesn't let you relax or play, but you have to be careful." "All these contraband items have been confiscated. Each squad leader will take the lead in reviewing them when they go back later, and they will hand them in tomorrow morning." "In addition, I would like to praise Class 3 here..." "Huh?" Zhou Kaidong and Lu Yang were surprised at almost the same time.How could neither of them expect that instead of being criticized, they would actually be praised?He Zhentao said: "Although the housekeeping standards of the third class are not the best, they are the only class in the company that has not found any contraband. In terms of discipline, the platoon leader has set a good example." "This week's disciplinary style is a moving red flag, and it is issued to you, the third class, in advance. You must continue to maintain it." "Yes!!" Zhou Kaidong's nose was filled with snot, and he almost couldn't be happy, and the happiness came too suddenly!Immediately afterwards, Gao Feng also spoke: "Hang that mobile red flag from Class 4 to Class 3! During this inspection, the internal affairs level of Class 3 has improved a lot, and we take it as a compliment!" Zhou Kaidong was almost stunned by the two sudden honors: "Thank you, company commander instructor!" Gao Feng was too lazy to look at the group of sticks anymore, waved his hand and announced the disbandment, asking them to quickly pick up the quilts.After the recruits were disbanded, they also began to play a game called "Find, Find, Find Quilt"."This quilt of yours seems to be mine, right?" "No, mine has a mark?" "I have a mark too!" "My mark was drawn on it by shooting a javelin in the middle of the night and drawing a map!" "Oh, oh, I'm sorry, I made the mark with a black pen, so you should take it away..." During the surprise inspection, the quilt was not thrown casually.The slightly better ones were thrown in the corridor, but the really bad ones were thrown out of the window after being ignored.If you're lucky, you can pick up a quilt in the flower bed on the ground, but I don't know if it's yours.I was really unlucky and was thrown into a tree. I had to climb up the tree to get the quilt off, but it turned out that it belonged to someone else's motherfucker.Kong Long was such an unlucky guy. He couldn't find his quilt after searching for a long time. Lu Yang gave him a trick and asked him to get a clean and odorless one. If he got it, he would earn money.Anyway, the total amount of quilts remains the same, and everyone will be assigned a bed in the end, so there is no need to worry so much.After giving Kong Long some instructions, Lu Yang quickly returned to the dormitory. Fortunately, the quilt was still on the bed.But the cigarettes and lighters in the cabinet were missing, apparently taken away.He scratched his head, puzzled?Obviously the contraband in his cabinet has been discovered, but nothing happened?"Hello, instructor!" "Lu Yang, come out." He Zhentao waved to him at the door, and Lu Yang quickly closed the cabinet and ran out.Originally, he thought he would definitely be scolded and punished this time.Unexpectedly, when no one was paying attention, He Zhentao gave him cigarettes and a lighter."It won't happen again." Looking at the instructor's back, Lu Yang finally understood why he was able to escape smoothly.He put the cigarette in his pocket and gave Zhou Kaidong a look after returning to the dormitory. The squad leader immediately understood.It was the instructor who worked secretly to save Lu Yang.In the army, rules and regulations are dead, but people are alive; as long as you are good enough, there will be great scholars to debate the scriptures.This also gave Lu Yang the motivation to work harder and be more positive.It turns out that what my cousin said is true. As long as you perform well in the army, you can smoke the squad leader's cigarettes and touch the company commander's butt as you like!...Zhou Kaidong hung the red flag of work style and discipline on the wall, looked at it with his hands on his hips, and couldn't help smiling on his face.The recruits in the third class were all happy and sincerely happy when they saw this moving red flag."What are you still doing? Go to Class 4 and pick up the other mobile red flag for me!" "Lu Yang, take the lead. You all can go together to prevent that old boy from Class 4 from cheating and denying his credit!" Ding Tengfei originally didn't want to join in the fun, but Zhou Kaidong ordered him to go, and he reluctantly followed the troops upstairs.For some reason, when he followed everyone upstairs, he felt like he was having a fight with someone outside.They are two opposing groups, both looking for trouble, and both looking for an explanation from the leader of the other party.Sure enough, when they arrived at the fourth class room upstairs, the door was closed tightly and they seemed extremely unwilling to cooperate.As the class deputy, Lu Yang went up and knocked on the door: "Fourth class leader, we are here to pick up the mobile red flag!" He shouted so loudly that other classes on this floor could hear clearly and came out to watch the fun.Soon, the fourth squad leader opened the door and looked at the playful Lu Yang with a gloomy look: "What are you shouting for? I'm not deaf!" Lu Yang chuckled and said, "We are here to pick up the moving red flag under the squad leader's order. You won't deny it, right?" The fourth squad leader was already angry, but now he saw a recruit dare to rub his nose in the face, and he immediately became angry.He did not dare to disobey the company commander's order, but he would never let these boys take down the flag of his squad so easily.The mobile red flag is the most valued collective honor of the grassroots troops, and it is the lifeblood of a class!The fourth squad leader summoned all the new recruits to block the door and pointed his thumb behind him aggressively."The mobile red flag is hanging behind the door of our class. Anyone who has the ability can come in and get it!" "Damn, isn't this a shame?" "It's too much for a veteran to bully a junior!" "Our squad leader Zhou Kaidong is a platoon leader, and his position is moreYou're so old, how can you be unreasonable?" The fourth squad leader blocked the door and scratched his ears: "Still, if you don't have the ability, get out and don't hinder our class' lunch break!" The recruits from the third squad were furious, obviously they didn't expect the other party to be so rogue.Lu Yang knew he might get into some trouble when he came up, but he didn't expect it to be so fucked up.It's useless to reason, and the other party has also made its attitude clear. Either we don't give it, or you can't get in on your own, or it's useless to go to the company commander.Because the army advocates force, the problem can only be solved by force at this time, and this is exactly what Lu Yang is least good at at the moment.But as the deputy of the third class, there is no reason to give in now that we are here. Today we must take back the flag of the fourth class!"Brothers, grab it for me!" Lu Yang gave the order and took the lead in rushing in.As soon as they made contact, he said something very fucking.With his small body, he is not suitable for taking the lead. Kong Long should be the one to take the lead!There were two groups of people at the scene, one pushing in and the other pushing out. It was like a scene during a wedding robbery.But only Lu Yang, who was in the middle of it, knew that this was just like American football, a violent physical contact.In the chaos, Lu Yang was punched in the nose, and his nosebleed was dried up at that time."Grass!" Seeing Hong, Lu Yang became more bloody.He lifted it up and kicked it hard, but he didn't know who he was kicking on.But looking at the painful expression on the fourth squad leader's face, it must have been a kick to him, and it was the kind that hit his weak point.The fourth squad leader gritted his teeth angrily and his voice became shrill: "You little bastard, you are so cruel, push them out!" Seeing that the confrontation became more intense, Lu Yang quickly covered his nose and retreated tactically.But there were people from Class Three behind them, and they couldn't squeeze out.Both sides were on top, and Lu Yang felt that his ribs were about to be broken by the crowd.He finally moved back a bit, but was forced to the front by Kong Long, an idiot.It made Lu Yang want to shout for help. He was still bleeding from the nose and his fighting ability was even weaker than before.Fortunately, at this moment, a hand stretched out from behind, grabbed his collar and pulled him out forcefully.At first, Lu Yang thought it was Zhou Kaidong who came, but when he looked back, he realized that it was Ding Tengfei who pulled him.Ding Tengfei rolled up his sleeves aggressively, pushed away the person in front of him, and kicked him, accompanied by a cry of national essence."I__your mother!" (Cloze)
